title: Dataverse Early-Bound TypeScript Generator config
description: Tool settings and saved projects for the Dataverse Early-Bound TypeScript Generator. dataverse-early-bound-typescript-generator-config.json holds the defaults bundled at build time; values saved in the tool are kept in PPTB's per-tool settings in the same shape.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor validation. Ignored by the tool.

deleteOrphanedFiles.description: Delete files in the output folders that the current selection no longer generates. Not applied yet: PPTB's file API can't delete files, so orphaned files are only reported.

projects.description: Projects created with the New Project dialog.

isoDateTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC, as written by Date.toISOString().

projectDefaults.description: Options a new project starts with: applied when a project folder without .dataverse-gen.json is opened. Projects that already have one keep their own values. Missing or mistyped keys fall back to dataverse-gen's defaults.

outputRoot.description: Output folder, relative to the project folder. Written to a new project's output.outputRoot. A blank value falls back to the default.

generateEntityTypes.description: Generate an early-bound interface per table for dataverse-ify. Written to a new project's generateEntityTypes.

generateFormContext.description: Generate a typed <Table>FormContext interface per table for form scripts. Written to a new project's generateFormContext.

generateIndex.description: Generate an index.ts that re-exports every generated file. Written to a new project's generateIndex.

project.description: A saved project. The tool skips entries missing id, name, location or createdOn, and fills in description, version and modifiedOn when absent.

name.description: Project name. Unique among saved projects, ignoring case.

location.description: Absolute path of the project folder, usually the one with package.json and .dataverse-gen.json.

version.description: Project version. Starts at 1.0.0 and gets a patch bump when a Generate run adds files or stops producing ones the previous run did.

modifiedOn.description: When a Generate run last added or dropped files. Defaults to createdOn.

lastGeneratedFiles.description: Output files the last Generate run produced, relative to the output folder with forward slashes. Absent until the project is first generated.
